name: travel-trip-lift-need
seed: S=$(echo '<account>' | sed 's/@/+stepfree@/') && php artisan mock:sample-day travel --email=$S && E2E_EMAIL=$S php artisan db:seed --class="Database\Seeders\MockSample\PaperworkSeeder" && E2E_EMAIL=$S MOCK_STEP_FREE=1 php artisan db:seed --class="Database\Seeders\MockSample\TravelSeeder"

init: if (location.pathname === '/up') { (async () => { const xsrf = decodeURIComponent((document.cookie.match(/XSRF-TOKEN=([^;]+)/) || [])[1] || ''); const headers = { Accept: 'application/json', 'X-XSRF-TOKEN': xsrf, 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest' }; try { const day = await (await fetch('/api/day?date=2026-09-30', { headers, credentials: 'same-origin' })).json(); if (day.active_trip) await fetch('/api/trip/end', { method: 'POST', headers, credentials: 'same-origin' }); } finally { location.replace('/timetable'); } })(); }

note: A lift out of order at Neumarkt (the mock's ?scenario=lift) on the trip card of someone who needs step-free ways (owner decision, 21 Oct 2026: a saved need), with the way open. The app side signs in as the account's `+stepfree` sibling: `php artisan mock:sample-day travel --email=<account+stepfree>`, then MockSample\PaperworkSeeder and MockSample\TravelSeeder with MOCK_STEP_FREE=1 for it. MockSample\SampleKvb gives the lift under the local mock_scenario cookie. The app's line in the opened way ("A lift at Neumarkt is out of order, and KVB doesn't say which platform it serves: this way may not be step-free.") has no counterpart in the mock's lift card. travel-trip-lift compares the card for everyone else. Each width starts with no trip running: the app side opens /up, ends any trip the account has through the app's own API, then opens Travel (as travel-plan-saved resets its planned way), so nothing a width leaves behind carries over.
